investigation.summary: Recorded Mobile Safari conversion and captured revenue fell while desktop remained stable. The cause is unconfirmed.

claims.finding: Mobile Safari checkout conversion fell from 20.00% to 8.57% across the recorded windows.
Captured Mobile Safari revenue fell from $1400.00 to $600.00; the baseline-rate projection exceeds observed revenue by $800.00.
Desktop checkout conversion stayed at 20.00%, contradicting a campaign-wide checkout decline.

limitations: This is a synthetic FIXTURE incident, not a LIVE revenue loss.
The observed pattern does not identify a root cause or establish causality.
